<reason>PRO won the decisive trade-off. CON's payment-is-coercion and contract dilemma were sharp, but PRO neutralized them with a workable split between enforceable pay/insurance/duty-to-take and unenforceable medical control plus pre-birth certainty, a need-vs-coercion distinction, and the export-underground harm of bans. CON's honest concession to leave parentage to post-birth court and rare maternal keep, plus a clipped Rebuttal 2, left PRO's child-certainty and safe-visible route live and cleaner.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>PRO Rebuttal 1 split of enforceable vs unenforceable terms plus pre-birth parentage orders, which directly defused the contract-dilemma and rejected-baby charges and forced CON onto defense about delivery-room uncertainty.</best_rebuttal>
